title: payments.payment_failed
description: A gateway declined a charge. Not published for an unknown outcome: a charge nobody answered for may have landed. Rules raise a follow-up for collections.

timestamp.description: When the fact was published, in UTC.

amount_minor.description: An amount in minor units of currency_code -- cents, centavos.

attempt_key.description: The attempt's idempotency key, unique per charge attempt.

failure_code.description: Why the gateway declined, as a closed code.

invoice_reference.description: The invoice the charge was for; null for a charge against no invoice.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same method later is sensible.

subject_id.description: The customer the fact concerns. Read them with GET /subjects/{id}.
